sentences.text: Parting Glances is an American film shot in 1984 and released in 1986 .

With its realistic look at urban gay life in the Ronald Reagan era and at the height of the AIDS crisis , many film critics consider it an important movie in the history of gay cinema .	Ronald Reagan	Ronald Reagan	gay cinema	List of lesbian, gay, bisexual or transgender-related films	AIDS	AIDS
It was also one of the first American films to address the AIDS pandemic .	AIDS	AIDS
First-time director Bill Sherwood died of complications due to AIDS in 1990 without ever completing another film .	Bill Sherwood	Bill Sherwood	AIDS	AIDS
